messages:
mira (eng-security): Heads-up — audit flagged model-serving pods (model-v2) reading configmap 'ingest-credentials' at 18:20 UTC after last night's RBAC refactor. That configmap contains third-party API keys. Suspect rolebinding change expanded permissions. Anyone else seeing this?

jasper (eng-platform): I pulled the diffs from the refactor: clusterrole 'model-reader' picked up 'get' on configmaps during consolidation. That was unintentional.

sam (oncall): @mira can you paste the pod names and audit event IDs? I'll prep an emergency rollback/deny.

mira (eng-security): Pod names: model-v2-5f8d7, model-v2-6c9a0. Audit IDs: 0a1b2c3d-9f8e-47a6-b2c1-aaa111bbb222. User: system:serviceaccount:ml:model-sa.

ana (eng-ml): Those service accounts should have only read access to model-metadata. Why would they need ingest creds configmap?

jasper (eng-platform): During the migration we moved a couple of non-sensitive items from secrets -> configmaps to avoid CSI complexity. We forgot to lock down the consolidated role.

ops-bot: deploybot: RoleBinding 'model-sa-configmap-reader' was applied by jenkins-pipeline #427 at 2026-03-19T02:12:11Z.

sam (oncall): Action plan (short): 1) revoke model-sa configmap read 2) rotate keys in the configmap + KMS envelope 3) run audit + egress checks 4) patch alerting to catch model-sa -> configmap reads. I'll do the RBAC deny now and post commands.

jasper (eng-platform): Commands I'm going to run in ml namespace:
```
# remove the accidental binding
kubectl delete rolebinding model-sa-configmap-reader -n ml || true
# create a minimal temporary role that only allows pod reads (no configmaps)
kubectl create role model-sa-temp-lock --verb=get,list --resource=pods -n ml
kubectl create rolebinding model-sa-temp-lockbinding --role=model-sa-temp-lock --serviceaccount=ml:model-sa -n ml
```

mira (eng-security): Also query audit logs for earlier accesses: `kubectl logs -n kube-system audit-logger | grep "system:serviceaccount:ml:model-sa" | grep configmap` — and check cloud audit export for full event payloads.

ana (eng-ml): I'll start rotating keys in staging and prepare prod rotation steps. We should envelope-rotate with KMS so we don't have to re-encrypt everything.

sam (oncall): Applied the temporary rolebinding. Confirmed model pods now get 403 when trying to GET the configmap.

mira (eng-security): Good containment. Next: check whether any downstream calls used those keys. Please check egress logs and third-party API telemetry.

jasper (eng-platform): S3/object-store logs show two small GETs from the ml cluster 18:19-18:21 UTC — likely background fetch. No large data exfil found in first pass. We'll escalate to cust-data for deeper log retention queries.

ana (eng-ml): Running quick smoke to detect external API usage with those keys — no anomalous outbound requests in the last 24h in staging. Will correlate with API provider logs.

mira (eng-security): If customer data was accessible, we treat as potential exposure. Filing incident and marking P1 until we have more evidence. We also need a rollback path for the RBAC refactor: revert the change or make role templates explicit per-resource.

ops-bot: incident-bot: Incident created INC-2026-089: possible configmap exposure via ml model-sa. Assigned: mira, jasper, ana, sam. Link: https://redwood.incidents/INC-2026-089

sam (oncall): I'll coordinate rotation with ana. Jasper will author a scoped RBAC revert and a follow-up PR that uses explicit RoleTemplates. Mira will lead the investigation and post audit queries in the incident.

mira (eng-security): I'll add the exact audit query set and list of affected resources to the incident. Also recommend adding a realtime alert: any serviceaccount outside kube-system reading configmaps with name matching '*ingest*' -> page sec oncall.

jasper (eng-platform): I'll draft the RBAC patch and a test that asserts model-sa cannot access configmaps in CI. We should also add a migration checklist item: 'do not widen configmap/secret scopes during consolidation'.

ana (eng-ml): Once keys are rotated I'll update connectors. Note: rotating KMS envelope key will require a short window where connectors re-auth — planning a <5m maintenance window.

mira (eng-security): Thanks everyone. Summary: containment done (temporary deny), investigation in progress (audit + egress + provider logs), mitigation (key rotation), long-term fix (RBAC role templates + CI assertion). Reconvene in 30m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
